title: On spectral stability for self-adjoint extensions
summary: We prove that given a symmetric completely non-selfadjoint operator $B$ with finite deficiency indices $(n,n)$ on a Hilbert space and a boundary triplet $\left(\mathbb{C}^{n},Γ_{1},Γ_{2}\right)$ for $B^{*}$, the set of points in the spectrum of $A_{1}$ (the self-adjoint extension with domain $Ker\;Γ_{1}$) which are not eigenvalues of maximum multiplicity for any self-adjoint extension of $B$ disjoint of $A_{1}$, is a dense $\textit{G}_δ$ set in $σ(A_{1})$.
